key_exclusions: Black Friday / Cyber Monday week pricing
policy_text_full: Best Buy refunds the difference if the price of an identical, in-stock item drops at Best Buy within the customer's return window. The window is 15 days for standard members and 60 days for My Best Buy Plus and My Best Buy Total members. Post-purchase competitor drops are not covered — only Best Buy's own price drops qualify.
policy_text_relevant_clause: If an identical product drops in price at Best Buy within the customer's return window (15 days standard, 60 days for Plus/Total members), Best Buy will refund the difference to the original tender.
